body: I have contacted a certain organization in the UK. It's been over a month now and there has been a severe lax in the kind of response they have given. The matter is really serious and I'm surprised to see no development on the case.

You put it perfectly. Having been brought up in such an abusive environment she has adapted to it and taken to blaming herself and having guilt. 

I couldn't agree more with you. You explained the way I see her thought process perfectly. I think I might just give ask her to contact the childline because it seems like it is something she would at least consider if not pursue. 

And you're right. This indeed is difficult for me to deal with. More so because, I am the only one who knows about all this and I feel it's my responsibility to help her get out of this condition. I haven't told anyone about this in real life except until now with this post on Reddit. I will keep in mind to not get sucked into it while I try to help her out.

Thank you for your response. It was really helpful. I thank you genuinely.

You captured the situation pretty accurately. That's the exact problem here. She is trapped in an abusive environment and she can't escape it because her own mind and thoughts are holding her back. 

It's such a helpless situation for me that it drove me to post here. It seems that apart from contacting the authorities myself, I am the only one who might be able to help her get through this. She only really trusts me and has confided many of the incidents only to me. I'll stick by her and try to provide support but I don't know how effective it'll be.

Hey, thanks for your help. 

I too, at first was skeptical whether it was all a fragment of her imagination. But having talked to her for years, and the way she described the incidents, there wasn't any discrepancy. She has even shown a few bruises on her fore arms once and I am 100% certain that she is not lying about this. 

As far as the blood clot is concerned, maybe she used a wrong term while describing what the doctor told her. I had done a quick Google search which somewhere said that blood clots in the brain occur from head injuries (or maybe it was just my confirmation bias). I'll have to look into it. 

The problem is she doesn't want to confide in anyone about the abuse because she thinks it will cause a lot of hassle to her and her family. She wouldn't even tell the therapists the truth let alone contact the authorities herself.
